tx:
The following actions will give a chance to drop this pet:
• mining essence
• mining ores
• mining gem rocks
• mining normal, red and crystal-flecked sandstone
• mining Seren stones in Prifddinas
• mining granite
• mining crablets at the Arc
• mining a crashed star
• mining in the Lava Flow Mine
• mining solid crystal on Tarddiad
The following actions will not give a chance to drop this pet:
• playing a minigame or Distractions and Diversion (other than Shooting Star) that rewards experience in this skill
• using a Divine rock

In a purely mathematical format, the chance f of receiving the pet on any particular action is
f = \frac{T \times S}{50,000,000}
Where:
• T is the amount of game ticks taken per action
• S is the virtual skill level. At 200 million experience, a flat bonus of 50 is applied to this value
